description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class for testing HTTP request actors within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes setup and teardown methods for the actor system, utility methods for sending and validating commands to modify thing attributes and send messages, and helper methods for creating headers and expected responses. The class is used as a base for testing specific HTTP request actor implementations.

classes.name: AbstractHttpRequestActorTest
classes.description: An abstract test class providing common setup, utility methods, and fixtures to facilitate testing of HTTP request actors in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Initializes the actor system and loads test configuration before tests run.

methods.name: afterClass
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after all tests have completed.

methods.name: testThingModifyCommand
methods.description: Tests sending a modify attribute command via HTTP request actor and validates the response.

methods.name: testMessageCommand
methods.description: Tests sending a message command via HTTP request actor and validates the response.

methods.name: buildSendThingMessageResponse
methods.description: Constructs a simulated response for a message command with specified payload and headers.

methods.name: createHttpRequestActor
methods.description: Creates an actor instance to handle an HTTP request for testing purposes.

methods.name: createAuthorizedHeaders
methods.description: Builds headers with authorization context for testing authenticated requests.

methods.name: createExpectedWhoamiResponse
methods.description: Creates an expected HTTP response for a 'whoami' request for validation.

methods.name: getAuthContextWithPrefixedSubjectsFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts and constructs an AuthorizationContext based on headers, used for authentication simulation.
